name: outbox-relay-hono
title: Outbox relay route (Hono)
description: routes/outbox.ts: a Hono route that relays each registered consumer's events.
docs: Needs the outbox block: `npx better-supabase add outbox`. Mount it with `app.route("/outbox", outboxRoutes)` and call it from a cron that sends `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/outbox.
